title: PRG32 Device Demo+
summary: Comprehensive PRG32 development-c6 hardware/runtime showcase including indexed graphics, bitplanes and SID-like synthesis.
description: Device Demo+ is the development-c6 successor to the standalone DeviceDemo cartridge. It exercises framebuffer drawing, controller input, indexed and bitplane sprites, tile/playfield and platform helpers, legacy audio, SID-like procedural instruments, tracker playback, portable diagnostics, WiFi/score state and portable cartridge packaging.
